Friendzy / Classic party games / Psychiatrist

How to play Psychiatrist

Diagnose the secret the room is hiding One player is the psychiatrist and leaves the room. The rest secretly agree on a shared condition. The psychiatrist comes back and asks yes/no questions to diagnose the group.

3–10 players~10 minMysterious & CleverSocial & discussion games🚗 Works in the car

How to play

  1. One player (the psychiatrist) leaves the room.
  2. Everyone else agrees on a shared condition or secret rule (e.g., 'we all think we're the person to our left').
  3. Psychiatrist comes back and asks yes/no questions to any player.
  4. Keep answers consistent with the condition — but don't make it too obvious.
  5. Psychiatrist gets 10 questions to diagnose. Then makes a guess.

Example round

  • Condition: 'Everyone answers as if they're the person to their right'
  • 'Do you like spicy food?' Person to the right loves it → 'yes'
  • Condition: 'Everyone thinks they're a celebrity.' 'Are you currently employed?' 'I am very well known, yes.'

Tips

  • Conditions that affect only answers are easier than ones that affect behavior.
  • Good conditions: everyone has an extra limb, everyone is hiding something, everyone is from the future.
